## The Finance Hiring Challenge

Audit season, quarter-end close, regulatory filings: finance teams face predictable crunch periods that exceed permanent staff capacity every year.

You need credentialed professionals (CPAs, CFAs, Series licenses) but credential verification takes time and temp agencies charge premium rates for qualified talent.

Regulatory requirements are increasingly complex. One mistake can mean fines, restatements, or reputational damage. You can't afford to compromise on expertise.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- CPAs, CFAs, and credentialed finance professionals with verified licenses
- Experience across public accounting, corporate finance, and financial services
- Specialists in audit, tax, FP&A, treasury, compliance, and risk management
- Familiar with major ERP systems: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday
- Confidentiality and regulatory compliance understanding built-in
